# MCP reference

`cg mcp` serves 15 tools over stdio. None of them edits or runs project code: `cg_index` writes only the graph cache, `cg_read` reads lines inside the project and every other tool runs the CLI command named in its section. The project is the one the server was started for; clients never choose the root or the command. Setup for Codex and Claude Code is in [Agents and MCP](../guides/agents-and-mcp.md).

| Tool | What it answers |
|---|---|
| [`cg_index`](#cg_index) | Index source files without executing them; writes only the graph cache. |
| [`cg_find`](#cg_find) | Find indexed symbols by name or wildcard. |
| [`cg_search`](#cg_search) | Retrieve bounded code evidence using local FTS5/BM25 and optional graph RRF; no model calls. |
| [`cg_locate`](#cg_locate) | Start here: from the text of a request or issue to the places to change, with their source, callers and tests, in one bounded answer; no model calls. |
| [`cg_show`](#cg_show) | Show an indexed symbol, signature and neighbours. |
| [`cg_callers`](#cg_callers) | Show callers and confidence; static evidence, not runtime proof. |
| [`cg_callees`](#cg_callees) | Show callees and unresolved calls. |
| [`cg_impact`](#cg_impact) | Find affected callers and candidate tests. |
| [`cg_verify_plan`](#cg_verify_plan) | Propose relevant tests and argv from static runner evidence; never run them. |
| [`cg_prepare`](#cg_prepare) | Prepare bounded evidence for a feature or symbol. |
| [`cg_flows`](#cg_flows) | Read the functional map: declared purposes linked to code with source witnesses; technical candidates are separate. Use cg_prepare on a declared ID for impact and tests. |
| [`cg_source`](#cg_source) | Read a bounded source window inside the indexed project. |
| [`cg_review`](#cg_review) | Inspect a diff and baseline; does not save baselines or execute tests. |
| [`cg_check`](#cg_check) | Report static candidates; not a compiler or test run. |
| [`cg_read`](#cg_read) | Read numbered file lines inside the project without executing code. |

## cg_index

Index source files without executing them; writes only the graph cache.

Runs `cg index`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `full` | boolean |  | `false` |  |

## cg_find

Find indexed symbols by name or wildcard.

Runs `cg find`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pattern` | string | yes |  |  |
| `kind` | string |  |  |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | `40` | min 1 |

## cg_search

Retrieve bounded code evidence using local FTS5/BM25 and optional graph RRF; no model calls.

Runs `cg search`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes |  | min length 1; max length 512 |
| `mode` | string |  | `hybrid` | hybrid, lexical |
| `limit` | integer |  | `10` | min 1; max 50 |
| `depth` | integer |  | `2` | min 1; max 3 |
| `min_conf` | string |  | `medium` | high, medium, low |
| `max_chars` | integer |  | `9000` | min 64; max 16000 |
| `json` | boolean |  | `true` |  |

## cg_locate

Start here: from the text of a request or issue to the places to change, with their source, callers and tests, in one bounded answer; no model calls.

Runs `cg locate`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes |  | min length 1; max length 200000 |
| `limit` | integer |  | `5` | min 1; max 10 |
| `max_chars` | integer |  | `5000` | min 512; max 16000 |
| `min_conf` | string |  | `medium` | high, medium, low |
| `json` | boolean |  | `true` |  |

## cg_read

Read numbered file lines inside the project without executing code.

Reads numbered lines directly; there is no CLI command.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |  |
| `start_line` | integer |  | `1` | min 1 |
| `end_line` | integer or null |  |  | min 1 |
